input.quote: 6.1 Upfront Payment. No later than [***] following the Effective Date, AbbVie shall pay Harpoon an upfront, non-refundable, non-creditable amount equal to Thirty Million Dollars ($30,000,000).
input.rationale: We searched the full agreement for MFN/best-terms concepts ("most favored", "favorable/favourable", "no less favorable", "as favorable as", "match", "best price", "offered to any Third Party") and reviewed Article 6 (Payments and Records) and Article 5 (Grant of Rights) in full. There is no obligation on AbbVie (Customer) to extend to Harpoon pricing or terms no less favourable than those given to any third party, and no obligation to match third-party offers. The only third-party-terms mechanics run the other way or are optional for us: Section 5.9.3 lets AbbVie elect (at its option) to take the benefit of Harpoon's future in-licensed rights and accept the associated terms, which is a right in our favour rather than an MFN burden, and Section 13.2.2 merely confirms AbbVie's payment obligations run in favour of Harpoon's permitted assignee. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no redline is warranted.
